items.title: Limits of the illusory truth effect for social-political opinions: Evidence from two experiments and a mini meta-analysis
items.whyItMatters: Potentially high-signal review that may confirm, narrow, or challenge claims already in the library.
items.result: Important boundary condition: two preregistered experiments found no meaningful repetition-driven increase in truth ratings for the tested social-political opinion statements. Used with the 2026 meta-analysis to narrow the canonical Illusory Truth claim without weakening the robust average effect for truth-judgment tasks.

items.title: Decision-Level Hijacking: Injecting Cognitive Bias into Large Language Models via Bit-Flip Attacks
items.whyItMatters: Potential update for the AI-assisted decisions research track; needs source review before changing any canonical claim.
items.reason: The paper studies adversarial weight manipulation that injects a targeted stance into a model. That is a security attack, not evidence that a named cognitive bias naturally occurs in normal model decision making.

items.title: Quality Action Assurance: Multimodal Verification of Examiner Claims in VR OSCEs
items.whyItMatters: Potential update for the AI-assisted decisions research track; needs source review before changing any canonical claim.
items.reason: False-positive discovery match. The paper uses an LLM to verify examiner claims in clinical exams; cognitive bias is part of the motivation, not the phenomenon being studied in the AI system.

items.title: Cognitive biases in AI-assisted medical decision making: A structured review as a primer for veterinary and human pathology.
items.whyItMatters: Potentially relevant to practical decision contexts and evidence-reviewed bias entries.
items.result: Useful structured review of cognitive biases during expert-AI diagnostic interaction. The review identifies 12 reported biases across its source corpus, while noting that direct pathology evidence remains sparse.

items.title: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Cognitive Biases in LLMs
items.whyItMatters: Large-scale benchmark covering 30 cognitive biases, 20 LLMs and 30,000 tests. Useful as a baseline for the project's AI-bias research map.
items.result: Used in the first AI bias research synthesis.

items.title: CogBias: Measuring and Mitigating Cognitive Bias in Large Language Models
items.whyItMatters: Reports family-dependent bias patterns and shows that prompt-level debiasing can help some bias families while worsening judgment biases in the tested models.
items.result: Included as provisional evidence in the first AI bias research synthesis.

items.title: Conditional Cognitive Biases in LLMs: How Biased User Turns Modulate In-Context Reasoning
items.whyItMatters: Tests bias expression in multi-turn interaction and suggests that biased conversational context can change later model behaviour. Relevant to real assistant use rather than isolated prompts.
items.result: Included as provisional evidence in the first AI bias research synthesis.

items.title: AIM-Bench: Evaluating Decision-making Biases of Agentic LLM as Inventory Manager
items.whyItMatters: Moves cognitive-bias evaluation into repeated operational decisions by LLM agents in inventory management. Useful for the project's agentic decision-making direction.
items.result: Included as provisional evidence in the first AI bias research synthesis.

items.title: What is Wrong With Automation Bias?
items.whyItMatters: Clarifies the role of contradictory evidence and distinguishes weaker and stronger forms of inappropriate reliance on automation.
items.result: Added as a current conceptual source to the Automation Bias evidence record; evidence status unchanged.

items.title: Humanlikeness as design, anthropomorphism as inference: a conceptual framework for human–robot interaction
items.whyItMatters: Separates humanlike design features from the psychological process of anthropomorphism, which directly supports the distinction used in our AI-assisted decision pages.
items.result: Added to Anthropomorphism and Appearance-Capability evidence records; evidence status unchanged.
